source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.documentation_quality: Adjuster notes, matching photos, itemised estimate and vehicle value present; no police report or statement, so good rather than certain very good.
reasons.notes_match_photos: Notes list bumper, bonnet and left headlight; photo captions cover exactly those areas.
reasons.settlement_path: Repair 6,200 EUR is about 73% of the 8,500 EUR market value, meeting the 70% total-loss definition.

ui_dependence: The terminology sets the total-loss threshold as a percentage of market value; without it the model must guess whether the estimate is high enough to count.
